messages:
Aisha: Quick poll — window seat lottery for today? Also thinking a one-liner chain while we wait :raised_hands:
Marco: Window seat please. One-liner to start: 'I put my plants on a vacation day.' :laughing:
Priya: In for both. One-liner: 'Coffee: the office's official programming language.' ☕
Li: Haiku incoming:
Li: 'Sun on my keyboard / Emails sing like tiny birds / I pretend it's warm'
Connor: @Aisha can seatbot run the lottery? or should we do the ancient ritual of rock-paper-scissors? :thinking_face:
seatbot: seatbot: Running random selection... 🎲
seatbot: seatbot: Lottery complete — window seat awarded to Marco. :tada:
Aisha: Congrats @Marco! :tada: New micro-rule: the best one-liner gets a sticker. Who's next?
Marco: I'll accept both the window and the sticker. One-liner: 'My keyboard is a crumb museum.'
Priya: Vote: sticker or snack prize? :cookie: :label:
Li: Snacks win for me. :100:
Connor: Snacks > stickers. Where's the cookie jar hiding these days? Asking for a friend.
Aisha: Snacks it is. Also, desk-haiku night at 7pm in conference room B? Low-commitment, high-snack. Who's in? :wave:
Priya: I'm in. Will bring emergency haiku ideas.
Marco: Bringing a tiny plant as an audience.
seatbot: seatbot: Noted: snacks for tonight + plant audience. 
Connor: Perfect. See you all at 7 — and may your one-liners be forever groan-worthy. :grin:
